title: 1145 Rewards Programme
subtitle: How to earn, track and use UCoin (UC)
intro: UCoin (UC) is the 1145 reward currency. You earn it across the 1145 ecosystem: shopping, rides, stays, leasing, driving, selling, creating content and referring friends. 1 UC is worth R0.10, so 10 UC takes R1 off at checkout.

body: Cashback is paid on the amount you paid in Rand (not the part paid with UC). Your tier sets the rate: 1% on Starter up to 3% on Diamond.

sections.title: Referrals
body: Share your referral code. A friend applies it within 30 days of joining. You earn as they qualify and use 1145.

sections.title: Tasks, surveys and campaigns
body: Open the Rewards tab, pick a task, do it and submit the link to your post. 1145 checks it and pays the UC when it is approved. Your tier multiplier applies to task rewards.

sections.title: Tiers and earning capacity
body: Your tier sets how much UC you can earn from everyday activity: check-in, base reward, browsing, cashback, tasks and referral activity. One-off bonuses (welcome, first purchase, milestones, referral qualification rewards, birthday, sponsored campaigns) are never limited.

Reach a tier for free with qualified referrals, or subscribe monthly to get it now. Your tier is whichever is higher. Subscriptions are paid through PayFast and can be cancelled any time; you keep the tier until the paid month ends.
sections.note: The Earning capacity card in the Rewards tab shows today's earnings by type and how much capacity you have left. When you reach a limit, everyday rewards pause until the next day (the 30-day limit rolls over continuously).

sections.title: Where to see your rewards
list: Wallet: your balance and every transaction, including which activity paid it.
Rewards tab: check-in, today's earning capacity, your tier, and your task submissions.
Notifications: you get one each time UC is added.

sections.title: Using your UC
list: Pay with UC at checkout: 10 UC = R1 off your order.
Send UC to another 1145 user from your Wallet. Any fee is shown before you confirm.

sections.title: Fair play
list: Rewards are only for real, verified actions. Each social account, post, product review and referral can earn only once.
Changes you make yourself (for example, marking your own ride complete) never earn rewards; the other party or 1145 confirms them.
Rewards earned through fake accounts, fake activity or misuse can be reversed, and the account removed from the programme.
Reward amounts, tasks, tiers and limits may change. The latest version of this guide is always in the app.

sections.title: Questions
faq: I signed up but didn't get the welcome bonus.
It is paid when your email is confirmed. If you signed up with Google or Facebook, it is paid straight away.
Why did I get less cashback than expected?
Everyday rewards stop at your tier's daily and 30-day limits. Check the Earning capacity card; a higher tier raises the limits.
My task says Submitted for review.
Tasks are checked by 1145 before paying. Make sure you added the link to your post.
When do referral rewards count towards tiers?
A referral counts once they verify email and mobile, or complete their first purchase.
What happens if I cancel my subscription?
Nothing changes until the month you paid for ends; then you move to the tier your referrals reach.
